option_relations.rationale: The option and leaf both describe Intravascular NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type, indicating a direct equivalence in their clinical entities.
There is no direct relation between Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma (IVLBCL) and the provided leaf, as they represent distinct lymphoma types.
Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm is a different clinical entity from the one described in the leaf.
Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, while related to NK/T-cell lymphomas, does not match the specific entity described in the leaf.
